with zipfile.ZipFile(wheel) as z:
 for name in ['torch/lib/libtorch_hip.so','torch/lib/libtorch_python.so','torch/lib/libc10_hip.so','torch/lib/libmagma.so']:
  with z.open(name) as f:
   header=f.read(64);assert header[:6]==b'\x7fELF\x02\x01';offset=struct.unpack_from('<Q',header,32)[0];size,num=struct.unpack_from('<HH',header,54);f.seek(offset);ph=[struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQQQ',f.read(size)) for _ in range(num)];dyn=next(p for p in ph if p[0]==2);f.seek(dyn[2]);data=f.read(dyn[5]);ds=[struct.unpack_from('<qQ',data,p) for p in range(0,len(data),16)];ptr=next(v for k,v in ds if k==5);length=next(v for k,v in ds if k==10);seg=next(p for p in ph if p[0]==1 and p[3]<=ptr<p[3]+p[5]);f.seek(seg[2]+ptr-seg[3]);strings=f.read(length);results[name]=[strings[v:strings.index(b'\0',v)].decode() for k,v in ds if k==1]
